name: Elopement Weddings
short: Intimate wedding celebrations for couples who want something deeply personal and beautifully simple.
intro: Elopement weddings are intimate celebrations designed around what truly matters. A beautiful place. The person you love. Your closest people. And a day that feels entirely yours.

PICNIC CLUB creates intimate elopement experiences throughout Portugal, from location scouting and styling to food, flowers and the smallest details — for two, or for a very close circle of loved ones.
included: Ceremony styling: the arch, the aisle and the flowers
A table for the celebration afterwards
The smallest details, from the rings to the signage
Coordination on the day, so you can simply be there
